stem: Before accepting an exception, a patient returns medication that the pharmacy dispensed in error. Select all supported actions.

choices.text: Given the described event, accept the returned medication under the error pathway.
In this setting, place sealed containers directly back on the shelf.
On this record, quarantine it and arrange proper disposal rather than returning it to saleable inventory.
For this scenario, returned erroneous medication must not be restored to saleable inventory.
Under these facts, the pharmacy remains responsible for proper disposition after quarantine.
